Lord '''Ondorru''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
During the [[Great Galactic War]], Ondorru was responsible of the [[Bombing of Fest|trap]] that forced the [[Dagger Wing]] [[Republic starfighter]] to fire on Imperial civilians, spreading false information. Around [[3641 BBY]], Ondorru was one of the top leaders of the Imperial troops that besieged the [[Belsavis prison]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. He was pursued by Dagger Wing and fought with Dagger Wing's leader, [[Conrad Gall]]. He effortlessly defeated Gall, but when the [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|leader of Havoc Squad]] arrived, he summoned beasts to cover his escape. The leader of Havoc Squad let Ondorru escape.

==Personality and traits==
Ondorru found that most beings in the galaxy were beneath his contempt, believing that the only beings worthy of his respect were Sith strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as himself&mdash;a rare group. He had almost no regard for other human beings and even less consideration for alien species, whom he considered little better than talking animals. Fellow Sith considered Ondorru a dangerously reckless individual. He was notorious for pursuing his passions without restraint, carelessly endangering anyone in his way. [[Darth Vowrawn]] once described him as a "capricious deviant," and his actions and attitudes bore the description out.
